name: Methixene
aliases: Metixene, metixene, Methixen, Metisene, Metixeno, Metixenum, SJ-1977, TRE232
summary: Metixene (brand names Methixart, CholinFall, Tremonil, Trest), also known as methixene, is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent. It has also been reported to induce incomplete autophagy and cell death in metastatic cancer and brain metastases.

pharmacology.text: Metixene (brand names Methixart, CholinFall, Tremonil, Trest), also known as methixene, is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent.

uses.text: Metixene (brand names Methixart, CholinFall, Tremonil, Trest), also known as methixene, is an anticholinergic used as an antiparkinsonian agent.

sideEffects.en: It can cause dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, trouble passing urine and a faster heart rate. Too much can cause confusion, agitation and hallucinations.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起口乾、視力模糊、便秘、排尿困難與心跳加快。過量可能造成混亂、躁動與幻覺。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起口干、视力模糊、便秘、排尿困难与心跳加快。过量可能造成混乱、躁动与幻觉。

fact.en: Methixene has a thioxanthene core, a three-ring system containing a sulfur atom, the same core found in antipsychotics such as flupentixol.
fact.zh: Methixene 以硫雜蒽為核心，這是一個含硫原子的三環系統，與氟哌噻噸等抗精神病藥的核心相同。
fact.zhHans: Methixene 以硫杂蒽为内核，这是一个含硫原子的三环系统，与氟哌噻吨等抗精神病药的内核相同。
